v17_label_normalization_findings.frozen_hypothesis: Cross-lingual legal_area label normalization materially improves hierarchy-family purity on identical embedding+machinery vs v16 raw values.
v17_label_normalization_findings.frozen_success_rule: At least one hierarchy-family purity metric improves >=20% over frozen v16 raw baseline on identical machinery; PASS/FAIL thresholds not loosened.
v17_label_normalization_findings.result: PARTIALLY REFUTED v16 attribution (nuanced): normalization improves hierarchy best_purity 0.3885->0.4669 (+20.2%), zoom fine_purity 0.01436->0.01756 (+22.3%), legal overall_purity 0.00826->0.00948 (+14.8%). Success rule met on 2/3 metrics.
v17_label_normalization_findings.mechanism_verified: Raw machinery re-run reproduces all three frozen v16 baseline values to <=1e-5, proving the raw-vs-normalized comparison is machinery-fair.
v17_label_normalization_findings.root_cause_finding: v16 '105 unique legal areas' attribution to pure data granularity is a MIS-DIAGNOSIS: dominant cause is UN-NORMALIZED CROSS-LINGUAL LABEL DUPLICATION (same Swiss area entered as separate de/fr/it strings), a correctable corpus-label defect actionable NOW, not blocked on 192k.
v17_label_normalization_findings.honest_nuance: Normalization alone does NOT flip these benchmarks to PASS (hierarchy purity 0.467 still < 0.7 threshold); residual 54 unique areas + coarse umbrella labels (public/civil/tax/NONE) still cap achievable purity. Not purely label error either.
v17_label_normalization_findings.product_decision_unlocked: Corpus lane should normalize legal_area labels before any hierarchy-family benchmark is judged; evaluation spec should define normalized label input for hierarchy/zoom/legal_area benchmarks; fractal-map hierarchy claim is NOT refuted by v16 raw numbers.

No rep worsened >10%. => v16 hierarchy-family universal FAIL was a representation-agnostic label artifact; RELATIVE product ranking NOT distorted.
v17b_label_normalization_all_reps_findin.product_decision_unlocked: linear_hybrid05_concat integration as COMBINATION map mode reinforced/unchanged; corpus lane should normalize legal_area labels before hierarchy-family benchmarks are judged.

cycle_description: v16: Full 14-benchmark formal suite applied to all v15 combinations + baseline + hybrid. Extends v15 (5 adversarial benchmarks) to 12 active benchmarks (2 SKIPPED: citation_heritage needs corpus citation graph, hierarchy_coherence/zoom_coherence/legal_area_clustering FAIL due to105 unique legal areas in 1200 decisions).

key_negative_findings: citation_heritage SKIP: 0 internal citations resolved in 1200-decision corpus. Citation graph references BGE/ATF numbers not mapped to corpus decision_ids. BLOCKED on corpus lane citation ID resolution pipeline.

hierarchy_coherence FAIL: All representations fail purity threshold (0.7) despite good NMI (0.33-0.52). Root cause: 105 unique legal_area labels in 1200 decisions = avg 11.4 decisions per area, making cluster purity mathematically unlikely.
zoom_coherence FAIL: All representations show negative improvement (-45% to -57%). Root cause: same as hierarchy_coherence - fine-grained legal areas cannot form coherent clusters at any resolution.
legal_area_clustering FAIL: Overall purity < 0.01 for all representations. Same root cause as above.

boilerplate_resistance_real_corpus FAIL: Text-embedding correlation -0.06 to +0.10 for all representations. Embedding similarity does NOT track text lexical similarity. This is a KNOWN systemic limitation documented in v3 evaluation.
cited_outcome_hybrid_0.5 FAILS tf_metadata_human_indexing (recall@5=0.7135 < 0.8 threshold). Citation-heavy representations sacrifice branch classification for cross-domain retrieval.
linear_citation_w3070 FAILS tf_metadata_human_indexing (recall@5=0.7930 < 0.8). Same tradeoff as cited_outcome_hybrid_0.5.
key_positive_findings: All 6 representations PASS 7/12 active benchmarks (or 6/12 for citation-heavy variants).
4/6 representations PASS tf_metadata_human_indexing (center_projected, linear_citation_concat, linear_hybrid05_concat, linear_citation_ridge).
linear_citation_concat, linear_hybrid05_concat, linear_citation_ridge MATCH center_projected_64dim baseline on full 14-benchmark suite (7/12 PASS).
No representation exhibits dimensional collapse (mean similarity < 0.17, std > 0.14).
All representations pass multilingual invariance and cross-language pairs - no language dominance artifacts.
All representations pass temporal stability (std < 0.005) - highly stable across random splits.
v16_full_benchmark_findings.product_recommendation: linear_citation_concat, linear_hybrid05_concat, and linear_citation_ridge are all valid product map modes, each matching the center_projected_64dim baseline on the formal benchmark suite. linear_hybrid05_concat has lowest JP variance (std=0.027) making it most suitable as default. cited_outcome_hybrid_0.5 remains best for user-imported corpora (no branch metadata). The105-legal-area granularity issue is a corpus data quality problem, not a representation limitation - to be re-evaluated when full corpus with coarser legal_area labels is available.
